limitations: Planning model, not certified crew or rover safety limits. DTM cannot resolve sub-metre obstacles. Unknown terrain requires inspection.

crew_caution_deg.source: IMPLEMENTATION section 5: suited crew in Mars gravity

crew_exclude_deg.source: NASA exploration EVA testing 2021, NTRS 20210000827; planning figure

rover_exclude_deg.source: Reported Perseverance figure, not a certified limit for Brianna's conceptual JPL Open Source Rover; replace from team CAD/sensor specifications when supplied

rockfall_height_factor.source: Team second-pass guidance: max(visible apron distance, one measured scarp height) from foot; not NASA-certified; reviewed edge/foot geometry required

roughness_m.source: Local elevation range; vertical uncertainty unavailable, so interpretation is uncertain; nearest odd pixel window approximates 3 m

wheel_slip_pct.source: disc-001 scenario; stop and request human input

wheel_drop_m.source: Perseverance example; sensor only, below DTM resolution; not evaluated by orbital algorithms; Brianna's CAD dimensions pending

belly_clearance_m.source: Reported Perseverance value; not a specification for Brianna's rover; sensor/CAD input only, never DTM-derived; team dimensions pending

hard_excursion_cap_m.source: NASA Walkback NTRS 20080013604; distance from habitat

eva_reserve_fraction.source: IMPLEMENTATION section 5; no physiology or oxygen model
